name: Extreme EA
summary: Extreme EA is a breakout-style expert advisor that identifies extreme price levels and enters trades when price breaks through these levels. It uses dynamic channel or range detection to define support/resistance boundaries and executes trades on breakout confirmations. The EA manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the breakout range.
summary_zh: Extreme EA是一个突破类智能交易系统，通过识别极端价格水平，在价格突破这些关键位时进场交易。它利用动态通道或区间检测来定义支撑阻力边界，并在突破确认后执行交易，通过突破区间来设定止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是识别价格的极端高点或低点，形成动态的突破通道。入场条件为价格突破近期极端高/低点时开仓做多或做空，属于典型突破交易策略。出场条件包括固定止损止盈，止损通常设在突破点的另一侧以控制风险。仓位管理采用手数参数控制，部分版本可能包含加仓逻辑。资金管理方面依赖用户设置的固定手数或基于余额的百分比计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生假突破导致连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA identifies extreme price highs or lows to form a dynamic breakout channel. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks above a recent extreme high for buy orders or below an extreme low for sell orders, representing a classic breakout trading approach. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with stops typically placed on the opposite side of the breakout point to control risk. Position sizing is controlled via lot size parameters, with some versions potentially including add-on position logic. Money management relies on user-configured fixed lots or balance-percentage-based calculations. While the strategy logic is clear, breakout strategies are vulnerable to false breakouts during ranging markets, which can lead to consecutive stop losses.
pros: 突破策略逻辑清晰，顺势交易胜率较高
具有止损止盈设置，风险可控
参数较少，使用简单方便
在趋势行情中表现良好，盈亏比合理
pros_en: Clear breakout strategy logic with favorable win rate in trending markets
Includes stop loss and take profit settings for controllable risk
Few parameters make it simple and easy to use
Performs well in trending markets with reasonable risk-reward ratio
cons: 震荡行情中假突破导致频繁止损
缺乏多时间框架确认，突破信号可靠性不足
仓位管理较为简单，未根据波动率动态调整
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能亏损
cons_en: Frequent stop losses from false breakouts in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, reducing breakout signal reliability
Position sizing is simplistic without volatility-based dynamic adjustment
No spread filter included, potentially causing losses in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，如更高周期趋势方向过滤
加入ATR动态止损止盈和波动率自适应仓位管理
增加点差和交易时段过滤，避免不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation such as higher timeframe trend direction filter
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and volatility-adaptive position sizing
Add spread and trading session filters to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损
缺乏点差过滤机制，滑点成本可能侵蚀利润
固定止损可能不适应当前市场波动率
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets
No spread filter mechanism, slippage costs may erode profits
Fixed stop loss may not adapt to current market volatility

The EA manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the breakout range.
